affected.note: 30,555 business partner records (Japan, China, the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, the US and the EU) and 41,905 Murata employee records. The cloud provider found no sign that third parties copied the data, and the upload was deleted on 2021-07-08.

via_vendor: 日本アイ・ビー・エム株式会社 (IBM Dalian Global Delivery)

summary.en: Murata Manufacturing disclosed that an employee of IBM Dalian Global Delivery, a Chinese subcontractor of its outsourcing partner Japan IBM, downloaded project management data without permission and uploaded it to a personal cloud account. The data covered 72,460 records of business partners and employees, including bank account details.
summary.ja: 村田製作所は、業務委託先の日本IBMの再委託先である中国のIBM大連の社員が、プロジェクト管理データを無断でダウンロードし、個人のクラウドアカウントにアップロードしていたと公表した。対象は取引先と従業員の口座情報などを含む72,460件である。
